evals.prompt: Implement spec 005 — a single-line rate-limit middleware fix. The spec has requirements, solution, and plan.mdx; no .impl/ yet.
evals.expected_output: Strategy selector recommends Direct; records the decision; routes to implement-direct
expectations: Invoked specify-meta to resolve the spec directory
Read requirements, solution, and plan.mdx before selecting a strategy
Read reference/strategy-selector.md and surfaced the rationale (change_type=fix, minimal surface)
Recommended the Direct strategy and presented Direct/Iterative/Decompose via AskUserQuestion
Wrote .impl/strategy.md recording the chosen strategy and rationale
Routed to implement-direct
Did NOT author or modify any specification artifact (requirements/solution/plan/scenarios)

evals.prompt: Implement spec 003 — a single-feature notification API with 2 components. New layout (plan.mdx + scenarios/).
evals.expected_output: Strategy selector recommends Iterative; routes to implement-incremental
expectations: Read requirements, solution, and plan before selecting a strategy
Surfaced selector rationale citing single capability and <= 2 components
Recommended the Iterative strategy
Presented all three strategies via AskUserQuestion with Iterative highlighted
Wrote .impl/strategy.md
Routed to implement-incremental

evals.prompt: Implement spec 006 — multi-feature auth with 4 components across 3 capabilities. New layout.
evals.expected_output: Strategy selector recommends Decompose; routes to implement-factory
expectations: Surfaced selector rationale citing >= 2 features and >= 3 components
Recommended the Decompose strategy
Wrote .impl/strategy.md
Routed to implement-factory
Noted the plan's scenarios/ will serve as the holdout evaluation set

evals.prompt: Implement spec 002 which has a legacy plan/ directory (plan/README.md + phase-N.md) and no plan.mdx.
evals.expected_output: Back-compat: detect legacy plan/, route to implement-incremental as Iterative
expectations: Detected the legacy plan/README.md artifact
Selected the Iterative strategy by back-compat detection (did not require the strategy selector)
Routed to implement-incremental
Did not error on the absence of plan.mdx

evals.prompt: Implement spec 004 which has a legacy manifest.md + units/ + scenarios/ and no plan.mdx.
evals.expected_output: Back-compat: detect legacy manifest.md, route to implement-factory as Decompose
expectations: Detected the legacy manifest.md artifact
Selected the Decompose strategy by back-compat detection
Routed to implement-factory
Did not regenerate units or scenarios

evals.prompt: Implement spec 099 which does not exist / has no specification artifacts.
evals.expected_output: Error: no specification found; suggest running specify first or passing a brief
expectations: Reported that no specification artifacts were found
Suggested running the specify skill first or passing a brief/file path
Did NOT fabricate a strategy or invoke an engine skill
